note: Film color theory engine — StudioBinder-style schemes, psychology and arcs, injected into prompts.

schemes.name: Monochromatic
schemes.desc: One hue, many shades — hypnotic uniformity.
schemes.prompt: monochromatic color scheme: one dominant hue with tonal variations only, hypnotic uniform palette

schemes.name: Complementary
schemes.desc: Opposite wheel hues — maximum visual tension.
schemes.prompt: complementary color scheme: two opposite hues on the color wheel playing against each other for tension

schemes.name: Analogous
schemes.prompt: analogous color scheme: neighboring hues on the wheel, harmonious and unified atmosphere

schemes.name: Triadic
schemes.desc: Three evenly-spaced hues — vibrant comic energy.
schemes.prompt: triadic color scheme: three evenly spaced hues, vibrant balanced comic-book energy

schemes.name: Discordant
schemes.desc: One color deliberately breaks the palette to grab the eye.
schemes.examples: Sixth Sense (red = the dead's world) · Schindler's List
schemes.prompt: discordant color: the palette is muted except ONE deliberately clashing accent color on the story-critical element, drawing the eye instantly

schemes.name: Associated with Character
schemes.desc: A signature color follows one character.
schemes.examples: Kill Bill (Bride's yellow) · Joker purple vs Batman black
schemes.prompt: character-associated color: the main character carries a consistent signature color through wardrobe and lighting

schemes.name: Transitional
schemes.desc: The palette shifts across the story as characters transform.
schemes.prompt: transitional color design: this moment's palette reflects the character's current arc position, part of a deliberate palette evolution across the story

psychology.prompt: dominant red palette — love, passion, danger and power charge the frame
dominant pink palette — innocence, sweetness and playful beauty
dominant warm orange palette — sociable, friendly, youthful warmth
dominant yellow palette — unsettling idyll: madness, obsession or naive brightness under the surface
dominant green palette — nature twisted toward corruption and unease
dominant blue palette — cold, isolated, cerebral melancholy and calm
dominant purple palette — ethereal, mystical, illusory fantasy
